body.statement: For every fixed permitted \(c\), the estimator \(\delta_n^\star\) is total and there is a finite \(B_c\) such that \[\max_y\mathbb E[(\delta_n^\star-\tau_c(y))^2]\le\frac1n-\Lambda_cn^{-4/3}+B_cn^{-3/2}.\] In addition, the minimax risk under the fixed independent design has the sharp expansion \[R_n^{\mathrm{ind}}(c)=\frac1n-\Lambda_cn^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3}).\]
body.justification: It converts the dual score and Airy feedback into a full-label finite-data procedure and fixes the restricted benchmark sharply.
body.gap: Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen prove this shape only for two arms; Hull's Theorem 1 has the same two-arm restriction and no multiarm second-order coefficient.
body.consumer: A trialist can implement this prespecified procedure as a restricted benchmark without treating it as a claim about unrestricted design optimality.
